description: Signature database for public profile-page probes. Data, not code: edit this file to add or fix a site, then run `d3ta1l3r calibrate --sites <id>` before trusting it.

provenance.how_to_verify: d3ta1l3r calibrate --sites <id>   # probes a handle that cannot exist, and optionally one that does: d3ta1l3r calibrate --expect-hit <id>=your_handle
provenance.honesty_note: These signatures were authored by hand and are NOT live-verified against the sites. Sites change layout without notice, which is why an ambiguous response is reported as an error (unknown) and never as a hit. Detector semantics: 'marker' requires a found_marker; 'absence' means HTTP 200 plus a known not-found phrase; 'status' is a plain 404/200 heuristic and may not claim better than medium confidence.

catalogue.note: Curated entries are authored and reviewed by hand. Catalogue entries are bulk-converted from the upstream dataset above and were NOT verified by probing the sites: their URL templates and not-found phrases are believed correct, not known correct. Tiers order sources by a documented noise score (detector, confidence claim, non-profile probe URL, adult site, weak phrase), so a higher mode adds the least noisy sources first.
